items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed. Block security-sensitive releases and new public exposure across the managed fleet. Evidence shows fleet-doctor has no completed run, operations deploy/uptime/error sweeps are unavailable, and authentication/access boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. No active vulnerability or compromise is established. Severity: high control-evidence uncertainty. Allow ordinary reversible growth only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior. Retain the existing read-only security evidence matrix; do not request duplicate telemetry, access credentials or private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions, add dependencies, deploy, or claim certification.
